name: domain-language
description: Language support for the Domain language (.domain) — syntax highlighting generated from the language itself (every primitive, all 144 expression builtins, Consider bindings, embedded foreign-language blocks) plus a language server (diagnostics, hover types, inlay hints, completion, go-to-Shikigami, quick fixes) for the JJK-themed Advent of Code pipeline language

domain.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `domain` executable used for the language server (`domain lsp`). Leave as `domain` to use the one on your PATH.

domain.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC communication between VS Code and the Domain language server (shown in the 'Domain Language Server' output channel).
